scripts/clean.ts.name: Clean build output
scripts/clean.ts.description: Deletes the .next cache and the fumadocs-mdx .source output before pnpm dev, as docusaurus clear did on master.

scripts/move-doc.ts.name: Move a doc
scripts/move-doc.ts.description: Moves a page with git mv, rewrites every link and include that pointed at it, updates meta.json and appends a redirect entry.
